'''Michael Ryan''' (born 26 July 1943) is an Irish épée, foil and sabre [[fencing|fencer]]. He competed at the [[1964 Summer Olympics|1964]] and [[1968 Summer Olympics]].<ref name="sports-reference">{{cite web |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ry/michael-ryan-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418015507/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ry/michael-ryan-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |title=Michael Ryan Olympic Results |accessdate=18 December 2010 |work=sports-reference.com}}</ref>
